title: Migrate the removed stats compression annotation
quote: - **HTTP compression of Envoy metrics (`prometheus_stats`) enabled by default.** — The annotation `sidecar.istio.io/statsCompression` was deprecated and removed. There now is the `statsCompression` option in proxyConfig to globally control compression support of the metrics endpoint (`prometheus_stats`) of Envoy. The default of this value is `true`, offering `brotli`, `gzip` and `zstd` depending on the `Accept-Header` sent by the client. Most metric scrapers allow individual configuration of compression. If you still need to override this per Pod, you can set `statsCompression: false` via the `proxy.istio.io/config` annotation.
remediation: Remove the deprecated `sidecar.istio.io/statsCompression` annotation. Use the `statsCompression` option in proxyConfig globally, or set `statsCompression: false` via the `proxy.istio.io/config` annotation for a per-Pod override.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["sidecar.istio.io/statsCompression"] != null) | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, .metadata.annotations["sidecar.istio.io/statsCompression"]] | @tsv' # output lists Pods still using the removed annotation

title: Review circuit breaker remaining metrics tracking

detection.reason: Whether the cluster relies on circuit breaker remaining metrics and whether the Istiod deployment sets DISABLE_TRACK_REMAINING_CB_METRICS cannot be represented by the allowed top-level spec or status predicates.

quote: - **Circuit breaker metrics tracking behavior change** — The default behavior for circuit breaker remaining metrics tracking has changed. Previously, these metrics were tracked by default. Now, tracking is disabled by default for better proxy memory usage. To maintain the previous behavior where remaining metrics were tracked, you can: 1. Set the environment variable `DISABLE_TRACK_REMAINING_CB_METRICS=false` in your Istiod deployment 2. Use the compatibility version feature to get the legacy behavior This change affects the `TrackRemaining` field in Envoy's circuit breaker configuration.
remediation: If you need to maintain the previous behavior where remaining metrics were tracked, set `DISABLE_TRACK_REMAINING_CB_METRICS=false` in your Istiod deployment or use the compatibility version feature to get the legacy behavior.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deployments -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, ([.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.env[]? | select(.name=="DISABLE_TRACK_REMAINING_CB_METRICS") | (.name+"="+(.value // ""))] | join(","))] | @tsv' # output shows Istiod deployment settings for the tracking environment variable

title: Review ambient iptables reconciliation behavior

detection.reason: Whether workloads are enrolled in ambient mode and the resulting in-pod iptables/nftables state are not settled by the allowed cluster inventory predicates.

quote: - **Ambient iptables reconciliation enabled by default** — Iptables reconciliation is now enabled by default for ambient workloads in release 1.29.0. When a new `istio-cni` DaemonSet pod starts up, it will automatically inspect pods that were previously enrolled in the ambient mesh and upgrade their in-pod iptables/nftables rules to the current state if there are any differences. This feature can be disabled explicitly with `--set cni.ambient.reconcileIptablesOnStartup=false`.
remediation: If you do not want this behavior, disable it explicitly with `--set cni.ambient.reconcileIptablesOnStartup=false`; otherwise review the effect on ambient workloads when a new `istio-cni` DaemonSet pod starts.
verifyCommand: kubectl get daemonsets -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image?; contains("istio-cni"))) | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, ([.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.args[]?] | join(" "))] | @tsv' # output identifies istio-cni DaemonSets and their startup arguments for manual reconciliation-setting verification

title: Review access to Envoy debug endpoints

detection.reason: External tools and their requests to Envoy debug endpoints are not represented in cluster inventory, so inventory cannot determine whether access will be affected.

quote: - **Debug endpoint authorization is now enabled by default.** — Tools accessing debug endpoints from non-system namespaces (such as Kiali or custom monitoring tools) may be affected. Non-system namespaces are now restricted to config_dump, ndsz, and edsz endpoints for same-namespace proxies only. To restore previous behavior, set ENABLE_DEBUG_ENDPOINT_AUTH=false.
remediation: Review tools accessing debug endpoints from non-system namespaces. Update them to use the permitted same-namespace endpoints, or set `ENABLE_DEBUG_ENDPOINT_AUTH=false` to restore previous behavior.

title: Ensure ztunnels support dry-run AuthorizationPolicy

detection.reason: The setting of AMBIENT_ENABLE_DRY_RUN_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY and whether each ztunnel proxy is below version 1.29 cannot be settled by the allowed cluster inventory predicates.

quote: - **Upgrading in Ambient mode with dry-run AuthorizationPolicy** — If you make use of dry-run AuthorizationPolicy and wish to enable this new feature the upgrade to 1.29 includes some important considerations. Prior to Istio 1.29, ztunnel did not have any capability to handle dry-run AuthorizationPolicy. As a result, istiod would not send any dry-run policy to ztunnel. Istio 1.29 introduces experimental support for dry-run AuthorizationPolicy in ztunnel. Setting `AMBIENT_ENABLE_DRY_RUN_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY=true` will cause istiod to begin sending dry-run policies to ztunnel, using a new field in xDS. A ztunnel below version 1.29 will not support this field. As a result, older ztunnels will fully enforce these policies which is likely to produce an unexpected result. To ensure a smooth upgrade, it is important to ensure that all ztunnel proxies connecting to an istiod with this feature enabled are new enough to correctly handle these policies.
remediation: Before setting `AMBIENT_ENABLE_DRY_RUN_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY=true`, ensure that all ztunnel proxies connecting to istiod are new enough to correctly handle dry-run policies; a ztunnel below version 1.29 will not support the new field.
verifyCommand: kubectl get daemonsets -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image?; contains("ztunnel"))) | [.metadata.namespace, .metadata.name, ([.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image] | join(","))] | @tsv' # output identifies ztunnel DaemonSets and their images for manual version verification
